name: gateway
description: Manage the nSelf AI gateway (nself-ai-gateway, port 3761): service health, provider key vault, quota usage, and routing rules.
author: nself

actions.quota: Show quota usage by provider and model

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port of its own, no HTTP server, and no database tables. It is a thin JWT-authenticated HTTP client to the nself-ai-gateway backend service (port 3761). The CLI surface itself has zero license checks, matching the Three-Surface Model (App/client tier is always free). Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/gateway_cmd*.go and cli/internal/gateway/* under CLI-R11. internal/gateway was only ever imported by these files (no other core command used it), so it moved wholesale; its own internal/ports dependency was narrowed to a 3-constant local copy, and the gatewayToken() helper's internal/auth.ReadAuthFile() call was narrowed to a local read-only copy of that one function, since cli/internal/auth (3666 lines: login/OAuth/device-code flows) is unreachable from this module and not something this plugin needs.
